kinds.PROVEN: mathematical theorem, proved or recomputed here
kinds.IMPORT: published result used exactly as published
kinds.POSTULATE: assumed; not derivable from the other nodes at present
kinds.INPUT: measured number that enters a choice or a formula
kinds.DERIVED: follows from PROVEN/IMPORT/POSTULATE/INPUT nodes and passes gates G1-G10
kinds.OBSERVATION: numerical agreement found after the target was known; not derived
kinds.FAILS: contradicted by a computation or by the record
kinds.CONJECTURE: open mathematical statement used as an assumption; listed wherever it is used
kinds.CONDITIONAL: theorem proved from PROVEN/IMPORT nodes plus at least one CONJECTURE

nodes.title: alpha^-1 = pi Gamma(1/5)^3/Gamma(2/5) = 137.035982 (Law 1)
nodes.basis: NOTE; DAG 'Observation: the derivation does not close'. Read as the on-shell (Q^2 = 0) value it differs from CODATA 2022, alpha^-1 = 137.035999177(21), by 1.6936e-5 (0.124 ppm, 806 sigma). The manuscript assigns the gap to the bridge C2, whose scale Q* is obtained by inverting the measured alpha, so the exact claim sits in C2. Law 1 rests on P8, which no published X_5 mechanism supplies; the one published mechanism that can supply P8's factor 3, a Kac-Moody level, fails the measured couplings by itself (NYS). Lean: Law 1 follows exactly from P2, P8, P9 (UGCT.Physics.law1); the kernel cannot see that P8 was chosen after the target was known. Evolutionary search (EVO, three pre-registered generations): no construct the hard constraints admit has grade 1 (T15, T17; conditional on K1), no charge of X_5 couples as weakly as 1/137 (T14), and Law 1's one grade-1 factor is the Laplace factor of the affine chart (T16)
nodes.action: Make exact through C2: derive delta = alpha^-1(0) - pi Gamma(1/5)^3/Gamma(2/5) = 1.6936(21)e-5 without the measured alpha and freeze it before comparison (G2, G8). Until then state Law 1 as an observation with its look-elsewhere odds (~3e-5 in its own family), and keep P8 and P9 as named postulates. X_5 alone cannot supply Law 1 exactly under the hard constraints (T14, T15, T17), so a derivation must add one physical object of scale weight 1/5 (EVO, relaxations R1-R3).

nodes.title: Candidate exact law alpha^-1 = pi Gamma(1/5)^3/Gamma(2/5) + alpha^2/pi = 137.0359991917 (0.7 sigma from CODATA 2022)
nodes.basis: found by search, not derived: in the pre-registered scan of 1,323 correction terms it is the only one within 1 sigma, and a random target gets such a hit 22% of the time; counting the base formula too (277k formulas), a two-step match this close happens for 0.5-1% of random targets (post hoc). Law 1 alone is the only one of those 277k formulas within 0.124 ppm (0.3% by chance). No mechanism found: Type I Gepner thresholds, Chowla-Selberg/Colmez heights, the BCOV invariant, rank-two attractors, Landau-Ginzburg central charges, exponential periods, kinetic mixing and the Gell-Mann-Low eigenvalue condition all fail to give alpha^2/pi (EXACT). Against single measurements: Rb 2020 -1.3 sigma, Cs 2018 +5.4 sigma, electron g-2 2023 (137.035999166(15)) +1.7 sigma, and +1.9 sigma against its 2025 theory update 137.035999163(15)
nodes.action: Find a mechanism that gives alpha^2/pi from first principles, or let future alpha measurements decide; the prediction 137.0359991917 has no free parameter.
